##### Project general facts

Ocean Pearl 1 and 2 is a visionary residential project by Samana Developers, redefining the concept of waterfront luxury. This majestic ode to the sea features a collection of one, two, three, and four-bedroom residences, where the rhythm of nature flows and serenades the soul. Rising gracefully along the waterfront, the magnificent structure exemplifies the flawless union of modern luxury and natural beauty, with sleek, contemporary lines complemented by expansive glass windows that reflect the shimmering waters and vibrant hues of the sky.

Residents enjoy an extraordinary array of world-class amenities designed to elevate every aspect of life. The exquisite grand main pool offers an expansive sanctuary for sun-drenched tranquility, while exclusive private pools provide unparalleled privacy. A state-of-the-art fitness center equipped with the latest Technogym equipment ensures a premium fitness experience. Every detail, from stylish balconies to pristine finishes, reflects unparalleled craftsmanship and luxury, creating a perfect blend of relaxation and vibrant energy.

Every residence at Ocean Pearl is a harmonious blend of luxury and tranquility, designed to provide an unparalleled living experience. Doors are crafted with European solid cores, and handles from renowned German brands add a touch of modern elegance. Kitchens feature soft-close mechanisms from renowned German brands and countertops adorned with exquisite Spanish porcelain tiles. Bedrooms are serene havens with plush furnishings and soft, neutral tones, while spacious layouts boast premium finishes and meticulous craftsmanship throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled by the serene sea yet just moments away from the city's prime areas, this exceptional location ensures residents are never far from where they need to be. Dubai Canal, Dubai Metro Route, Port Rashid, Dubai Creek, Deira, and Al Mamzar Beach Park are all within easy reach, while Dubai International Airport, Dubai Gold Souq, and Heritage Village are conveniently accessible.

The location is distinguished by its perfect blend of connectivity and tranquility. From bustling business districts to premier shopping destinations, world-class dining and entertainment, every convenience is within reach. The ease of connectivity makes every journey effortless, allowing residents to spend more time enjoying the beauty and comfort of their exquisite home.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront opulence, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of serene sea views, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience life's majestic moments unfold each day with perfection — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
